stderr:
agent-firewall — local deterministic permissions for AI agents

Usage:
  agent-firewall check <action> <target> [--agent <id>]

Examples:
  agent-firewall check shell.exec "git status"
  agent-firewall check shell.exec "git push origin main" --agent codex
  agent-firewall check filesystem.read "./.env"
